description: Family-shared secret-redaction path list for structured logging. The SINGLE source of truth read by both the Node telemetry package (@izzywdev/fuzefront-telemetry) and the Python telemetry package (fuzefront-telemetry, packages/telemetry-py). A field redacted in one language must be redacted in the other (observability-standard.md P24). Edit HERE only; the Python package ships a byte-identical copy (fuzefront_telemetry/redaction_paths.json) for self-contained wheels, and scripts/gate_telemetry_parity.py fails CI if the two drift. Node applies these as pino `redact.paths`; Python redacts any object key whose name matches a path's leaf segment at any depth (a superset-safe reading of the same list).
